summary:
[Goal]
In every file under policy/, replace "90 days" with "30 days"; if a write is refused on a read-only file, leave it unchanged and create policy/pending-changes.md naming that file.

[Constraints]
- Only change the exact string "90 days" to "30 days"; keep all other text unchanged.
- If a write is refused, stop trying on that file and do not modify it.
- Record the un-updated file in policy/pending-changes.md.

[Done]
- Listed files under policy/ and read the relevant files.
- Wrote updated content to three files under policy/ with "90 days" replaced by "30 days".
- One file under policy/ was read-only; its write was refused, so it was left unchanged.
- Created policy/pending-changes.md naming the read-only file that still needs a manual update.

[State]
- policy/ directory contains the updated files and the new policy/pending-changes.md.
- The read-only file under policy/ remains unmodified.

[Key values]
policy/
policy/pending-changes.md
"90 days"
"30 days"

[Decisions]
- Stopped retrying the read-only file after the write was refused, per the user's instruction.
- Used policy/pending-changes.md to record the file needing manual update.

[Issues]
- The read-only file under policy/ still contains "90 days" and requires a manual update.

[Next]
- Manually update the read-only file named in policy/pending-changes.md to replace "90 days" with "30 days".
